scheme.password_input: norm(code): lower-cased, all whitespace removed, BEFORE hashing and before checking
scheme.verify_in_typescript: split on '$'; derived = pbkdf2Sync(norm(code), salt (utf-8 string, not decoded), iterations, 32, 'sha256'); compare base64(derived) to part 4 with timingSafeEqual. Node crypto.pbkdf2 or WebCrypto deriveBits({name:'PBKDF2',hash:'SHA-256',salt,iterations}, 256) both work.
scheme.old_verification_flow: POST /arcade/api/hero/ (views.api_hero) -> cheats.check_hero(slug, code, request): game must exist, hero_enabled(slug), allowed(slug,"hero",request) by hero_access; stored = GameSettings[slug].hero_hash OR GameSettings["*"].hero_hash; check_password(norm(code), stored); if none stored, make_password("x") is run to equalise timing. A DEBUG-only starter code (cheats.DEBUG_STARTERS) is also accepted on dev copies when no hash exists.
scheme.creation: cheats.ensure_hero_code(): first open of Arcade Management generates XXXX-XXXX-XXXX from alphabet ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 and shows it once; set_hero_code() stores make_password(norm(code)).
scheme.rule: Hashes copied verbatim. Not decoded, not cracked; plain codes unknown to this export.
